Episode 159. Kings' Duel (3)
The Monarch who shouted was Twelve King, Kaio.
'Brother Kaio?'
Everyone turned to look at Kaio. He was so furious that his clenched fist was trembling.
"Tw, Twelve King Brother. What's wrong?"
"Did you lose to Brother Garmund on purpose?"
A few warriors who didn't read the atmosphere properly asked Kaio, but he didn't answer. Tantel, who was quick to catch on, coughed and stopped them from talking.
A heavy silence fell in an instant.
Jin had never seen anyone among the brothers show such anger since he came to Lafrarosa.
"...It seems you have some dissatisfaction with me, Twelve King Brother."
Garmund narrowed his eyes and looked at Kaio. His pupils contained a much deeper and darker fighting spirit than what he had when he was fighting Jin just a moment ago.
"That's right, you're finally ready to fight."
"Don't beat around the bush and speak straight."
"You should have shown that look when you were fighting Jin."
"What did you say?"
"If you're going to treat Brother Jin like a child, why don't you change his diapers too?"
"You're crossing the line...Twelve King Brother. It seems like you're trying to cross a line."
"It's the Eight King Brother who crossed the line first. Do you think the other brothers don't know that you intentionally lost to Brother Jin just now?"
"I just lost! The accumulated shock from the morning duel was greater than I thought, and, and! Jin was stronger than I expected."
"We usually call that an intentional foul. Eight King Brother secretly hoped that Jin would win. That's why you didn't take the duel seriously."
"I told you it's not like that, stop talking nonsense...!"
"If it's really not..."
Kaio took big strides towards Garmund.
"Stake the honor of Brother Tushin and all the brothers. Did Eight King Brother wholeheartedly fight? If you say so, I'll cut off my right arm."
Seeing Kaio's determined face up close, Garmund unconsciously took a step back.
He wasn't intimidated by Kaio's vigor or afraid of confrontation.
Because there was something prickling about his words. In fact, every word of Kaio's was hitting Garmund's weak point.
"Why can't you answer, Eight King Brother?"
"Hmm, hmm! That...thing. I really didn't, but Brother Twelve King said he'd cut off his arm."
"It's a shame that I'm a king like Twelve King Brother."
"Eh... I really did fight properly and lost. Do I have to be involved in this and get scolded, Brother Twelve King?"
Teto, who had been listening, raised his voice in protest, and Rumora roughly wrapped his neck.
'Be quiet, Brother Twelve King. It's an important issue.'
'No, Brother Twelve King isn't speaking nicely. Let me speak up! Why is he being mean to me when I was quiet? Hah, me. Because I'm the weakest, do they really see me as an easy target?'

'Do you want to fight with Brother Kaio? Can you be Brother Twelve King, huh, can you!? Listen to me. And after all, since Brother Twelve King also lost to Brother Jin, it's a fact that he hurt the pride of the King Brothers.'
Teto couldn't win against Rumora's strength and only floundered.
Kaio didn't even care about Teto.
"So you're saying you won't answer even in this humiliating situation? Brother Eight King."
"It seems Brother Twelve King thinks he's Brother Tushin. Why should I follow Brother Twelve King's words..."
The next moment, all the Monarchs were taken aback.
Wham-!
Kaio suddenly punched Garmund in the jaw. It was a powerful blow that sent shockwaves throughout the hall.
[Oh, that must really hurt. Looks like his jaw might be broken.]
Garmund staggered as if about to fall, then narrowed his eyes.
"Kaio, you bastard!"
Just as Garmund tried to retaliate,
"Stop."
Vahn spoke up for the first time.
And for a while, Vahn didn't add anything else, just looking down at his brothers from the ring.
"The 7th duel is over. The winner is Brother Jin. The next duel will take place after an hour's rest."
Instead, he announced the results of the fight in a calm voice, then disappeared somewhere.

Among all the Monarchs, except Tushin, there was no hierarchy. If you insist, Jin, the successor to the Tushin and Sigmund, is nominally next in line after Vahn, but actual recognition was another matter.
That's why what happened now happened.
Jin certainly rose to the rank of a strong man among the Monarchs and became the successor of the Holy Sword and Tushin.
But he hadn't yet been recognized for his power by all the brothers.
Being recognized as a brother and being recognized as a King, a successor, were clearly different areas.
'Brother Tushin left without intervening in the fight......'
'Is it meant to not stop the siblings' fight? This level of severity hasn't been seen since the decisive battle with the gods.'
'Even before the decisive battle, such occurrences were rare. It's startling.'
'Is it true that the Twelve Brothers and the Eight Brothers deliberately lost?'
'Is it worth fighting over so much? What's wrong with Jin Brothers doing well. Frankly, I think the Twelve Brothers are being too sensitive. After all, only Jin Brothers are our only hope.'

'That's right. Initially, if it wasn't for the Jin Brothers, we couldn't even go outside. Moreover, Jin Brothers never blindly trusted the favoritism of the Fighting God Brothers and ran around like a thunderstorm, right? They always proved it. That's why they became brothers!'

'Well, that's true, but if you think about the meaning of the Fighting King's Tournament... I can understand the feelings of the Twelve Brothers. Honestly, it hasn't been long since Jin Brothers became our brothers.'

'And Jin Brothers have all the things that the Fighting King Brothers had hoped for in a short period of time. Because they were chosen by the Fighting God Brothers. In any other time, these things would have been nearly impossible.'
'More than anything, the Twelve Brothers... Until the extinction, they were the ones who strived the most to become the successor of the Fighting God Brothers. No one can deny this.'
The warriors whispered and shared their opinions with each other.
They had no idea why Vahn had left his seat so casually. That's why they didn't stop the fight carelessly.
Jin was also confused.
The brothers he knew never bared their teeth at each other.
Also, from the moment Jin was recognized as a brother, he never experienced discrimination or hostility, and always received full support.
This is the racial trait and characteristic of the Myeongwang tribe.
Jin sometimes felt that there was no group more ideal than the Myeongwang tribe.
An absolute leader and a single person, and people who never betray each other with equality and trust.
However, as Tantel mentioned earlier. Myeongwang tribe were also people.

-We haven't always cherished each other sincerely like now, Jin Brothers. There have been many betrayals, murders, conspiracies, and schemes in the history of the Myeongwang tribe. It was just less than other races.

-The era of the current Fighting God, Sister Vahn, was indeed a golden age for the Myeongwang tribe. So, there were no murders in the Fighting King Tournament held before the extinction, but it was not the case before. They divided into factions and fought, and some even deliberately killed their opponents to achieve political goals.
Suddenly, Boras's words came to mind.
'The golden age of the Fighting God Brothers... ended with a challenge to the gods and a result of extinction.'
The ideal image of the brothers that Jin had seen so far, perhaps.
It might have been possible because this place, Lafrarosa, was a 'dead world'.
The time of the Myeongwang tribe stopped. Even when Temar found Lafrarosa as the first successor, and even a thousand years later, when Jin came, Lafrarosa was a society without a future.
All that the Myeongwang tribe in it could do was to give everything they had to the only two successors who had visited over a long period of time.
"Therefore, they no longer had the need to compete with each other. There was no need to struggle to become the successor of Tushin, nor was there any reason to strive.
However, now that Jin has declared that he will return them to the world, meaning has been restored to their time.
They found a reason to live, their desires revived, and the spark of dreams was kindled.
In other words, they were no longer ghosts for the sole purpose of the successor, but could greet tomorrow as human beings.
Therefore, some brothers were convinced that this tournament should be as fair as it is fierce.
Even though the successor of the sacred sword can only be Jin, they thought that the successor of Tushin could change.
'To remove the rust and moss that had settled in the stagnant history of Myungwang, inevitably, struggle and fight must accompany.'
The tournament was the last test that Vahn gave to Jin and all other Myungwang, and it was a purification site.
If you want to make history flow again, you have to shake off everything.
For that, Jin concluded what he should do.
"Twelve Kings Brothers."
Jin looked at Kaio with his back on Garmund.
"If you don't like the actions of the Eight Kings brothers, you can trample me with all your might when it's your turn."
"I intend to do so, Jin brother."

"And regardless of the sincerity of the Eight Kings Brothers, the result is unchanged that I won. This is not a competition, it's a fight. Whether the Eight Kings Brothers have done their best or not is not important now."
"Yeah, that's right."

"So it would be good to stop making a fuss now. Just like the Eight Kings Brothers said, the Twelve Kings Brothers are behaving as if they have become Tushin Brothers. There is no hierarchy among brothers. I can't command or force. It's only allowed to Tushin brothers."
The Myungwangs were divided into those who nodded as if they agreed with Jin's opinion, and those who were still.
Jin decided to become a villain who instigated their struggle.
He decided to become a villain who had to acknowledge by winning in the end.

"In my opinion, the Twelve Kings Brothers seem to be convinced that they are stronger than the Eight Kings Brothers. Otherwise, they couldn't insult the Eight Kings Brothers in front of all the brothers."
Kaio's eyes became more fierce.
"…Really? It's an interesting story. Then, is it the same context that Jin brother is pushing me now? Are you saying that Jin brother is teasing me because he is sure that he is stronger than me?"
At that, Jin smiled.
"Exactly. The Twelve Kings Brothers won't be able to beat me."
